authority: Root在用户已授权单次版本补证及最新查因推进要求内，明确metadata准入实现映射及逐job临时guard边界；不是人类逐字批准具体mapping/manager配置，也不是新资源授权。

admission.stage: one metadata-only collector under sustained supervisor and independent fallback
preserved_checks: immutable root-owned controller/config/epoch permit and fixed role/unit/argv bindings
actual own cgroup and shared64/project512 memory/swap/oom gates before activation
protected root administrative controllers only; no Subject or token access
same absolute270/300 with revoke/stop/kill/reap/restoration and independent physical final witness

clock.t0: Workflow captures time.monotonic before /run controller/config creation and before any guard/unit setup; literal parsing/imports collect no versions.
clock.manager_secondary_bound: RuntimeMaxSec recomputed from original remaining; SIGKILL controls before outer as secondary only.
clock.always: Read-only actual resource evidence and saved terminal; no new cleanup/restoration/grace.

topology_and_reference.reused: COW management children, monotonic remaining, nonblocking kernel writes, bounded stop/show/noJob, cleanup-once receipts, epoch permits, protected controls, postdrop reread, independent fallback and physical final witness.
topology_and_reference.changed_for_metadata: Common xiongbaowork-metadata.slice64 added under ordinary project512; all controls+collector counted. No original Source/runtime/install/prepare/brand or A/B operations.
topology_and_reference.scope_specific: Supervisor uses normal systemd-run --scope so registered PID execs controller, STDIO inherits Actions descriptor; collector --pipe client is inside supervisor.scope16. No long outside DATA-forwarding client.
topology_and_reference.scope_exit: Actual command returncode plus inactive/failed noJob and physical scope empty/absent-after-exit; no service MainPID success assumption.
topology_and_reference.actual_platform_support: NOT_RUN; unsupported/rejected scope or other primitive fails closed, no guessed fallback.

temporary_operations.operation: Create immutable controller.py0444 and privateconfig0600 under exact /run/xb-platform-<run>-<attempt>
temporary_operations.scope: This run only, root-owned O_EXCL; t0 already running; no version or Source read.
Fixed per-job resource guard definitions, O_EXCL collision rejects; no /etc or manager-global policy/enable.
Only make fixed ephemeral resource guards available. No service upgrade/install/persistent enable or network probe.

temporary_operations.operation: Initial actual512/shared64/swap0/empty checks then kernel oom.group1 admission
temporary_operations.scope: Fixed bootstrap guard setup only; unexpected memory/swap/populated rejects before collector.

temporary_operations.operation: Fallback transient.service16 and supervisor.scope16; collector.service32 with fixedrootwrapper
temporary_operations.scope: Common64; every subsequent management/command descendant counted; all runtime caps read back, unsupported properties fail.
Only supervisor/fallback inside common64 and only original remainder. No outside restore writer.

temporary_operations.operation: Final physical project/shared limits+pop0 and owned control quiet evidence
temporary_operations.scope: Fixed outside normal Actions read-only witness; saves only its own administrative observations, never reads/parses version payload or Subject.

temporary_restoration_boundary: Restores original job resource baseline project512/shared64/swap0/oom1 and proves whole aggregates empty. Fixed temporary unit definitions remain for exact final evidence until ephemeral runner teardown; no claim of persistent/global manager configuration restoration. Existing final oom0/absent/missing/late conditions keep whole job FAILED_OR_UNKNOWN.

metadata_allowlist.binary: Existing unprivileged disk binary/version/package and /proc1 attempts unchanged. Additional narrow root-admitted fixed /proc/1/exe snapshot described separately; no alternate PID, environment, cmdline, source reads or privileged metadata commands.
metadata_allowlist.package: Only dpkg-query -S exact validated systemd binary and -W systemd with binary:Package, fullVersion, Architecture, source:Package, source:Version, installed status. Patch names are full version metadata, not vendor patch-content proof.
metadata_allowlist.os: Bounded root-owned stable os-release data with ID/VERSION_ID/VERSION/PRETTY_NAME/BUILD_ID only; no source/eval.
metadata_allowlist.runner_image_provisioner: Coordinator joins native setup metadata of this exact newrun/job; collector does not read environment or usernames.
metadata_allowlist.prohibitions: No token, network probe, Source/oldexports/SQL/SDK/packageinstall/upgrade/userdata/globalmanager edits. No metadata field is inferred from Ubuntu name; no backfill to prior runs.

output.transport: Collector stdout through in-scope client and inherited ActionsFD. Raw32768 report never goes through8192 call_bounded management pipe.
output.privileged_resources: Separate root-owned receipts from actual kernel/systemctl reads only. Privileged fixedPID1 snapshot is metadata evidence, never resource proof. Neither version output enters final fixed-resource COW callback.
output.status: Per-query unsupported/timeout/outputcap/permission errors explicitUNKNOWN. A complete bounded metadata report may exist even when final resource gate fails.

controller.usage: Exact bytes also inline immutable in workflow, no runtime code/network fetch.

proof_level: Author pure construction/connector hash+readback only; no parser/compile/test/collector/job execution. Exact successor differs only final evidence deadline supervision, actual environment clearing, fixed in-admission PID1 metadata snapshot and verified literal OS owner aliases, with necessary pins/plan. No self-review approval.
next_action: Different nonauthor fully rereads this exact successor3-file package, including complete resource emission timing, actual env-i launch chain and fixed PID1 privileged-read boundary. Only valid sole leaseowner after idlequeue/dedup may create unchanged reserved runbranch once; c7 remains blocked/unrun.

revision_history.finding: Final observe/record/emit and always completion not fully supervised against original outer; startup CLI env did not prove fallback service env.

deadline_finding_response.scope: Fixed outside resource-only final read/record/emit boundary; no version or restoration.
deadline_finding_response.implementation: Dedicated COW child with own session and tiny<=1024B nonblocking ACK pipe supervises complete final_observation, full<=16KiB root receipt save and stdout flush, emission marker, child actual completed_at, parent reap and post-call remaining checks.
deadline_finding_response.large_receipt: Full resource receipt is written/emitted directly by child; never transported through existing8192B management pipe or ACK.
deadline_finding_response.always: Actual kernel read+saved root terminal/emission marker read+complete stdout flush run in the same dedicated COW supervision with original outer. Child/caller actual completion must be before outer; old observed_at alone cannot pass. Any ACK/record/emit/reap timeout fails native step and whole job; no new grace.
deadline_finding_response.receipt_boundary: Printed verified status is provisional until supervised ACK and native step success, explicitly labelled. Version metadata is already independent output and is not discarded on resource failure.

environment_chain_correction.bootstrap_and_always: sudo invokes the same fixed env-i chain before Python; no reading/printing inherited environment.
environment_chain_correction.scope: Actual Popen explicit PATH=/usr/bin:/bin and LC_ALL=C; normal --scope execs controller with that whitelist. -I/-B isolate Python; supervisor children and collector query commands pass explicit whitelists.
environment_chain_correction.collector: Existing irreversible-drop os.execve explicit whitelist unchanged; no service-manager default environment is asserted clean merely from its startup client env.

fixed_pid1_admission_snapshot.purpose: Within already existing privileged collector rootwrapper and only after actual own32/shared64/project512 gates+epoch/clock have passed; before irreversible drop. This is a narrowed metadata read inside existing root admission, not new capabilities or global privilege expansion.
fixed_pid1_admission_snapshot.interface: Only fixed /proc/1/exe readlink plus stable FD/named/rootownership SHA256 streaming. PID1 target must be exact systemd binary allowlist path (optional deleted suffix); no arbitrary PID1 path emitted/read.
fixed_pid1_admission_snapshot.bounds: Existing inner remainder, binary16MiB cap/64KiB stream, root metadata record<8192B, common32+16+16 memory budgets unchanged.
fixed_pid1_admission_snapshot.record: Root-owned0600/nlink1 per-run pid1.metadata.json, exact root record hash/bytes emitted with source/runID/attempt/headSHA and explicit not_resource_restoration_proof. It cannot be read as collector authorisation or resource restoration receipt.
fixed_pid1_admission_snapshot.failure: Permission/unsupported/nonallowlisted PID1 target is explicit UNKNOWN; no ptrace/LSM/proc/CAP changes, no elevation after drop and no disk-binary substitution for runningPID1.
fixed_pid1_admission_snapshot.unprivileged_boundary: Normal managerVersion/systemd--version/dpkg/uname/osrelease commands remain postdrop. Existing unprivileged /proc1 observations may still be UNKNOWN and do not overwrite the separately sourced root capture.

usrmerge_owner_alias_fix.scope: Only fixed /usr/lib/systemd/systemd and /lib/systemd/systemd literal OS aliases.
usrmerge_owner_alias_fix.gate: Each exact alias must resolve to already validated root-owned systemd binary, trusted executable permissions and stable FD/named dev/ino/bytes/SHA256 must match that binary. Only then dpkg-query -S receives the original literal alias; do not canonicalize /lib query into /usr.
usrmerge_owner_alias_fix.outcome: Both raw alias identities and owner results remain separately associated. Different/unsupported/missing alias or failed owner query is explicit UNKNOWN; no wildcard inventory, fuzzy owner, install or download.
usrmerge_owner_alias_fix.collector_delta: Only this existing owner-metadata path changed; managerVersion/kernel/os/cap/deadline/normal unprivileged commands unchanged.
